groups.meta: Rotation C is the 4th reward, ~25 minutes in
conditions: Waves run on a fixed timer; killing faster does not end them sooner. Rewards follow AABC, so C is the 4th completion, about 25 minutes.
Stay through reward 4 before deciding whether to continue; most public players quit at reward 3, mistaking it for C.
If you keep going, only leave on a multiple of 4 to hold enemy levels down and keep teammates around.
bonuses: Each completed rotation gives 10 of each fragment type (15 on Steel Path); every 50 Citrine's Remnants collected gives 5 more (7 on Steel Path).

A flight or mobility frame collecting Remnants (Titania, Jade, Wukong, Uriel, Chroma) adds roughly 150 of each fragment per 4-round run in pubs; grab the bulk that spawns in the 30-second Void tunnel too.
Steel Path gives 15 per rotation and 7 per Remnant set instead of 10/5, and a full frame runs about 3-4 hours there versus 4-5 on normal.

disclosures.title: solo tricks
disclosures.body: A New Loka Ancient Guardian Specter set to hold position, or a Loki Decoy (Damage Decoy augment), pulls aggro off the crystal. A Frost bubble, Vauban with Enduring Bastille, or max-range Hydroid with Pilfering Swarm also work. Warframe heals do not restore crystal health; only Remnant pickups do, capped around 50% damage reduction from other sources.

disclosures.title: the actual bottleneck
disclosures.body: 9.3% is the highest single-part rate in the game and duplicate main blueprints are common, with no way to convert a dupe into fragments. Boosters and Smeeta Charm do not affect fragment or part drops.

groups.activity: buy whatever parts are still missing
groups.meta: 1,550 Rania + 1,500 Belric for a full set from scratch
conditions: Hold fragments until only 1-2 parts are missing so a late drop cannot duplicate a purchase.
Otak's prices run roughly an order of magnitude above comparable pity shops (Jade, Dante, Voruna, Koumei).
